Generated Narrative: StructureMap SMSpecimenHistologyIHCMSI

map "https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureMap/sm-specimen-histology-ihc-msi" = "SMSpecimenHistologyIHCMSI"

uses "https://dnpm-dip.net/fhir/StructureDefinition/dnpm-lm-patient-record" alias DNPMPatientRecord as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle" alias Bundle as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Specimen" alias Specimen as produced
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport" alias DiagnosticReport as produced
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation" alias Observation as produced

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Root group: iterate over the whole PatientRecord and populate the Bundle
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group SpecimenHistologyIHCMSI(source src : DNPMPatientRecord, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // Bundle type = collection
  src -> bundle.type = 'collection' "bundleType";
  // --- Specimen (one per specimens entry) -----------------------------------
  src.specimens as spec ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Specimen') as s then {
    spec.id as specid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', specid) "fullUrl";
    spec -> s then MapSpecimen(spec, s) "map";
  } "specimen";
  // --- DiagnosticReport + child Observations per histologyReport -----------
  src.histologyReports as hr ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('DiagnosticReport') as dr then {
    hr.id as hrid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', hrid) "fullUrl";
    hr -> dr then MapHistologyReport(hr, dr, bundle) "map";
  } "histologyReport";
  // --- DiagnosticReport + child Observations per ihcReport -----------------
  src.ihcReports as ihc ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('DiagnosticReport') as dr then {
    ihc.id as ihcid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', ihcid) "fullUrl";
    ihc -> dr then MapIHCReport(ihc, dr, bundle) "map";
  } "ihcReport";
  // --- Observation per msi finding -----------------------------------------
  src.msiFindings as msi ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
    msi.id as msiid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', msiid) "fullUrl";
    msi -> obs then MapMSIFinding(msi, obs) "map";
  } "msiFinding";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapSpecimen: DNPM specimen entry → FHIR Specimen
// Profile: MII (parent: Specimen)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapSpecimen(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Specimen) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "specimenId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-tumor-specimen' "specimenProfile";
  } "specimenMeta";
  // subject → Patient reference
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "specimenSubjectRef";
  } "specimenSubject";
  // type → CodeableConcept
  src.type as t -> tgt.type as typ then {
    t -> typ.coding as c then {
      t.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "specimenTypeCode";
      t.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "specimenTypeSystem";
    } "specimenTypeCoding";
  } "specimenType";
  // collection block
  src.collection as col -> tgt.collection as tcol then MapSpecimenCollection(col, tcol) "specimenCollection";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapSpecimenCollection: DNPM collection → FHIR Specimen.collection
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapSpecimenCollection(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : BackboneElement) {
  src.date as dateDt -> tgt.collectedDateTime = cast(dateDt, 'dateTime') "collectedDateTime";
  // bodySite
  src.site as site -> tgt.bodySite as bs then {
    site -> bs.coding as c then {
      site.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "bodySiteCode";
      site.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "bodySiteSystem";
    } "bodySiteCoding";
  } "bodySite";
  // method
  src.method as meth -> tgt.method as m then {
    meth -> m.coding as c then {
      meth.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "methodCode";
      meth.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "methodSystem";
    } "methodCoding";
  } "collectionMethod";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapHistologyReport: DNPM histologyReport → FHIR DiagnosticReport
// Also creates child Observation entries for tumorCellContent and
// tumorMorphology and links them as DiagnosticReport.result references.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapHistologyReport(source src : BackboneElement, target dr : DiagnosticReport, target bundle : Bundle) {
  src.id as idV -> dr.id = cast(idV, 'string') "drId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> dr.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-histologie-befundbericht' "drProfile";
  } "drMeta";
  src -> dr.status = 'final' "drStatus";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> dr.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "drSubjectRef";
  } "drSubject";
  // specimen[0]
  src.specimen as spec -> dr.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "drSpecimenRef";
  } "drSpecimen";
  // issued — append timestamp suffix so it becomes a FHIR instant
  src.issuedOn as d -> dr.issued = append(d, 'T00:00:00Z') "drIssued";
  // --- tumorCellContent child Observation -----------------------------------
  src.results as res ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
    res.tumorCellContent as tcc then {
      tcc.id as tid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', tid) "fullUrl";
      tcc -> obs then MapTumorCellContent(tcc, obs) "tccMap";
    } "tccInner";
  } "tccEntry";
  // link result reference from DiagnosticReport
  src.results as res -> dr.result as r then {
    res.tumorCellContent as tcc then {
      tcc.id as tid -> r.reference = append('urn:uuid:', tid) "tccRef";
    } "tccInner";
  } "drResultTCC";
  // --- tumorMorphology child Observation ------------------------------------
  src.results as res ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
    res.tumorMorphology as tm then {
      tm.id as tmid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', tmid) "fullUrl";
      tm -> obs then MapTumorMorphology(tm, obs) "morphMap";
    } "morphInner";
  } "morphEntry";
  // link result reference from DiagnosticReport
  src.results as res -> dr.result as r then {
    res.tumorMorphology as tm then {
      tm.id as tmid -> r.reference = append('urn:uuid:', tmid) "morphRef";
    } "morphInner";
  } "drResultMorph";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapTumorCellContent: DNPM tumorCellContent → FHIR Observation
// Profile: MII_PR_MTB_Tumorzellgehalt
// code: LOINC 93356-4 (Cells with cytogenetic abnormality)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapTumorCellContent(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "tccId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-tumorzellgehalt' "tccProfile";
  } "tccMeta";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "tccStatus";
  // Fixed LOINC code per mii-pr-mtb-tumorzellgehalt profile
  src -> tgt.code as code then {
    src -> code.coding as c then {
      src -> c.system = 'http://loinc.org' "tccCodeSystem";
      src -> c.code = '93356-4' "tccCodeCode";
    } "tccCodeCoding";
  } "tccCode";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "tccSubjectRef";
  } "tccSubject";
  // specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "tccSpecimenRef";
  } "tccSpecimen";
  // valueQuantity: multiply fraction × 100 to get percent
  src.value as v -> tgt.valueQuantity as vq then {
    v -> vq.value = v "tccQtyValue";
    v -> vq.unit = 'percent' "tccQtyUnit";
    v -> vq.system = 'http://unitsofmeasure.org' "tccQtySystem";
    v -> vq.code = '%' "tccQtyCode";
  } "tccValueQuantity";
  // method
  src.method as meth -> tgt.method as m then {
    meth -> m.coding as c then {
      meth.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "tccMethodCode";
      meth.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "tccMethodSystem";
    } "tccMethodCoding";
  } "tccMethod";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapTumorMorphology: DNPM tumorMorphology → FHIR Observation
// Profile: Observation (base — no dedicated MII MTB profile yet)
// code: LOINC 59847-4 (Histology and Behavior ICD-O-3)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapTumorMorphology(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "morphId";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "morphStatus";
  // Fixed code for morphology
  src -> tgt.code as code then {
    src -> code.coding as c then {
      src -> c.system = 'http://loinc.org' "morphCodeSystem";
      src -> c.code = '59847-4' "morphCodeCode";
      src -> c.display = 'Histology and Behavior ICD-O-3 Cancer' "morphCodeDisplay";
    } "morphCodeCoding";
  } "morphCode";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "morphSubjectRef";
  } "morphSubject";
  // specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "morphSpecimenRef";
  } "morphSpecimen";
  // valueCodeableConcept from first morphology entry
  src.morphology as morph -> tgt.valueCodeableConcept as vcc then {
    morph -> vcc.coding as c then {
      morph.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "morphValueCode";
      morph.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "morphValueSystem";
    } "morphValueCoding";
  } "morphValue";
  // notes → Annotation.text (one per note string)
  src.notes as n -> tgt.note as ann then {
    n -> ann.text = n "morphNoteText";
  } "morphNote";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapIHCReport: DNPM ihcReport → FHIR DiagnosticReport
// Also creates child Observation entries for each proteinExpression and
// each msiMmr entry and links them as DiagnosticReport.result references.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapIHCReport(source src : BackboneElement, target dr : DiagnosticReport, target bundle : Bundle) {
  src.id as idV -> dr.id = cast(idV, 'string') "ihcDrId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> dr.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-ihc-befundbericht' "ihcDrProfile";
  } "ihcDrMeta";
  src -> dr.status = 'final' "ihcDrStatus";
  // Fixed code for IHC panel report: SNOMED 1264497003 (Histology report)
  src -> dr.code as code then {
    src -> code.coding as c then {
      src -> c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "ihcDrCodeSystem";
      src -> c.code = '1264497003' "ihcDrCodeCode";
      src -> c.display = 'Histology report (record artifact)' "ihcDrCodeDisplay";
    } "ihcDrCodeCoding";
  } "ihcDrCode";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> dr.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "ihcDrSubjectRef";
  } "ihcDrSubject";
  // specimen[0]
  src.specimen as spec -> dr.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "ihcDrSpecimenRef";
  } "ihcDrSpecimen";
  // issued
  src.issuedOn as d -> dr.issued = append(d, 'T00:00:00Z') "ihcDrIssued";
  // --- proteinExpression entries -------------------------------------------
  src.results as res then {
    res.proteinExpression as pe ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      pe.id as peid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', peid) "fullUrl";
      pe -> obs then MapProteinExpression(pe, obs) "map";
    } "peEntry";
    // link into DiagnosticReport.result
    res.proteinExpression as pe -> dr.result as r then {
      pe.id as pid -> r.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "peResultRef";
    } "drResultPE";
    // --- msiMmr entries (IHC-based MSI/MMR proteins) ----------------------
    res.msiMmr as mmr ->  bundle.entry as e,  e.resource = create('Observation') as obs then {
      mmr.id as mmrid -> e.fullUrl = append('urn:uuid:', mmrid) "fullUrl";
      mmr -> obs then MapMsiMmrObservation(mmr, obs) "map";
    } "mmrEntry";
    // link into DiagnosticReport.result
    res.msiMmr as mmr -> dr.result as r then {
      mmr.id as mid -> r.reference = append('urn:uuid:', mid) "mmrResultRef";
    } "drResultMMR";
  } "ihcResults";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapProteinExpression: DNPM proteinExpression → FHIR Observation
// Profile: MII_PR_MTB_Immunohistochemistry
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapProteinExpression(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "peId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-immunohistochemistry' "peProfile";
  } "peMeta";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "peStatus";
  // code: always include the generic IHC SNOMED code (profile constraint)
  src -> tgt.code as code then {
    // generic IHC code (pattern)
    src -> code.coding as cGen then {
      src -> cGen.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "peCodeGenSystem";
      src -> cGen.code = '1234806008' "peCodeGenCode";
      src -> cGen.display = 'Observation using immunohistochemistry (observable entity)' "peCodeGenDisplay";
    } "peCodeGenCoding";
    // protein-specific code (open slice)
    src.protein as prot -> code.coding as cSpec then {
      prot.code as codeV -> cSpec.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "peCodeSpecCode";
      prot.system as systemV -> cSpec.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "peCodeSpecSystem";
    } "peCodeSpecCoding";
  } "peCode";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "peSubjectRef";
  } "peSubject";
  // specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "peSpecimenRef";
  } "peSpecimen";
  // valueCodeableConcept
  src.value as val -> tgt.valueCodeableConcept as vcc then {
    val -> vcc.coding as c then {
      val.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "peValueCode";
      val.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "peValueSystem";
    } "peValueCoding";
  } "peValue";
  // component: tps-score (integer) — only when present
  src.tpsScore as tps -> tgt.component as comp then {
    tps -> comp.code as code then {
      tps -> code.coding as c then {
        tps -> c.system = 'http://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov' "peTpsCodeSystem";
        tps -> c.code = 'C184941' "peTpsCodeCode";
        tps -> c.display = 'PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score' "peTpsCodeDisplay";
      } "peTpsCodeCoding";
    } "peTpsCode";
    tps -> comp.valueInteger = tps "peTpsValue";
  } "peTpsComponent";
  // component: ic-score (CodeableConcept) — only when present
  src.icScore as ic -> tgt.component as comp then {
    ic -> comp.code as code then {
      ic -> code.coding as c then {
        ic -> c.system = 'http://loinc.org' "peIcCodeSystem";
        ic -> c.code = '85315-2' "peIcCodeCode";
        ic -> c.display = 'PD-L1 immune cell score [%] in Tissue by Immune stain' "peIcCodeDisplay";
      } "peIcCodeCoding";
    } "peIcCode";
    ic -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vcc then {
      ic -> vcc.coding as c then {
        ic.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "peIcValueCode";
        ic.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "peIcValueSystem";
      } "peIcValueCoding";
    } "peIcValue";
  } "peIcComponent";
  // component: tc-score (CodeableConcept) — only when present
  src.tcScore as tc -> tgt.component as comp then {
    tc -> comp.code as code then {
      tc -> code.coding as c then {
        tc -> c.system = 'http://loinc.org' "peTcCodeSystem";
        tc -> c.code = '83053-9' "peTcCodeCode";
        tc -> c.display = 'Cells.programmed cell death ligand 1/Viable tumor cells in Tissue by Immune stain' "peTcCodeDisplay";
      } "peTcCodeCoding";
    } "peTcCode";
    tc -> comp.valueCodeableConcept as vcc then {
      tc -> vcc.coding as c then {
        tc.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "peTcValueCode";
        tc.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "peTcValueSystem";
      } "peTcValueCoding";
    } "peTcValue";
  } "peTcComponent";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapMsiMmrObservation: DNPM ihcReport.results.msiMmr entry → FHIR Observation
// Profile: MII_PR_MTB_Immunohistochemistry_MSI (IHC-based MMR protein expression)
// code: LOINC 62862-8 (Microsatellite instability … by Immune stain)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapMsiMmrObservation(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "mmrId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-msi' "mmrProfile";
  } "mmrMeta";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "mmrStatus";
  // Fixed LOINC code per mii-pr-mtb-immunohistochemistry-msi profile
  src -> tgt.code as code then {
    src -> code.coding as c then {
      src -> c.system = 'http://loinc.org' "mmrCodeSystem";
      src -> c.code = '62862-8' "mmrCodeCode";
      src -> c.display = 'Microsatellite instability [Presence] in Tissue by Immune stain' "mmrCodeDisplay";
    } "mmrCodeCoding";
  } "mmrCode";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "mmrSubjectRef";
  } "mmrSubject";
  // specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "mmrSpecimenRef";
  } "mmrSpecimen";
  // code also carries protein info as an additional coding (gene/protein studied)
  src.protein as prot -> tgt.code as code then {
    prot -> code.coding as c then {
      prot.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "mmrProteinCode";
      prot.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "mmrProteinSystem";
    } "mmrProteinCoding";
  } "mmrProtein";
  // valueCodeableConcept (expression result: exp_present / exp_absent / …)
  src.value as val -> tgt.valueCodeableConcept as vcc then {
    val -> vcc.coding as c then {
      val.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "mmrValueCode";
      val.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "mmrValueSystem";
    } "mmrValueCoding";
  } "mmrValue";
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MapMSIFinding: DNPM msiFindings entry → FHIR Observation
// Profile: MII_PR_MTB_Mikrosatelliteninstabilitaet (NGS-based MSI)
// code: LOINC 81695-9 (Microsatellite instability [Interpretation] in Cancer specimen Qualitative)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
group MapMSIFinding(source src : BackboneElement, target tgt : Observation) {
  src.id as srcId -> tgt.id = cast(srcId, 'id') "msiId";
  // Profile meta
  src -> tgt.meta as m then {
    src -> m.profile = 'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-mikrosatelliteninstabilitaet' "msiProfile";
  } "msiMeta";
  src -> tgt.status = 'final' "msiStatus";
  // Fixed LOINC code per mii-pr-mtb-mikrosatelliteninstabilitaet example
  src -> tgt.code as code then {
    src -> code.coding as c then {
      src -> c.system = 'http://loinc.org' "msiCodeSystem";
      src -> c.code = '81695-9' "msiCodeCode";
      src -> c.display = 'Microsatellite instability [Interpretation] in Cancer specimen Qualitative' "msiCodeDisplay";
    } "msiCodeCoding";
  } "msiCode";
  // subject
  src.patient as pat -> tgt.subject as subj then {
    pat.id as pid -> subj.reference = append('urn:uuid:', pid) "msiSubjectRef";
  } "msiSubject";
  // specimen
  src.specimen as spec -> tgt.specimen as sRef then {
    spec.id as sid -> sRef.reference = append('urn:uuid:', sid) "msiSpecimenRef";
  } "msiSpecimen";
  // effectiveDateTime
  src.issuedOn as issuedOnDt -> tgt.effectiveDateTime = cast(issuedOnDt, 'dateTime') "msiEffectiveDateTime";
  // valueCodeableConcept — DNPM interpretation code (e.g. MSI-H, MSI-L, MSS)
  src.value as val -> tgt.valueCodeableConcept as vcc then {
    val -> vcc.coding as c then {
      val.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "msiValueCode";
      val.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "msiValueSystem";
    } "msiValueCoding";
  } "msiValue";
  // method (IHC / PCR / bioinformatics)
  src.method as meth -> tgt.method as m then {
    meth -> m.coding as c then {
      meth.code as codeV -> c.code = cast(codeV, 'string') "msiMethodCode";
      meth.system as systemV -> c.system = cast(systemV, 'string') "msiMethodSystem";
    } "msiMethodCoding";
  } "msiMethod";
}
